title: Lodge a residential bond claim (landlords and agents)
summary: Landlords and agents can submit a claim for a bond refund through their Rental Bonds Online (RBO) account if they believe the tenant owes money for a legitimate reason.
intro:

Note: Before you submit a claim, discuss any deductions first with your tenant. This may help avoid a dispute about a bond claim later, and may result in the tenant agreeing to the claim.

faqs.q: What should I do before submitting a bond claim?
faqs.a: Before submitting a claim, discuss any deductions first with your tenant. This may help avoid a dispute about a bond claim later, and may result in the tenant agreeing to the claim.

faqs.q: What happens if I dispute the claim and don't take action?
faqs.a: If you take no action, and after 14 days the bond will be refunded as per the tenant’s claim.

faqs.q: What should I do if I disagree with the claim?
faqs.a: Within 14 days, inform Fair Trading that you've applied to NCAT for a hearing to dispute the claim.
